settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 2 pm ship the same working day. Most arrive in 2 to 4 working days.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, to the UK, EU, US, Canada and Australia. Duties are shown at checkout, never on delivery.

settings.question: Can I return something I have used?
settings.answer: Yes. Brew with it for up to 30 days and send it back in its box if it is not right for you.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer: Two years on kettles and grinders, parts and labour, for manufacturing faults.

settings.question: Can I buy spare parts?
settings.answer: Lids, burrs, seals and filters are listed in the Spare parts collection. Write to us if you cannot find yours.

settings.heading: Orders, returns and care
settings.text: Still stuck? Contact us and a person will reply.
